content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Jr. Research Fellow Vacancy Details 2026
Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: 1st class Postgraduate (M.Tech./M.Sc.) degree in Polymer Science, Fibre Science, Chemistry, Nanotechnology, or allied areas, preferably with experience in polymer synthesis and characterization with NET/GATE. The requirement of NET/GATE examination for the selection to the post of JRF/SRF may be relaxed for the candidates who have graduated from Centrally Funded Technical Institutes (CFTIs) with a CGPA of more than 8.000 (80% aggregate marks).

How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Delhi Jr. Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 02-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Delhi Jr. Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Jr. Research Fellow position at IIT Delhi is 02 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Jr. Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Jr. Research Fellow position at IIT Delhi as per the latest notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a 1st class Postgraduate (M.Tech./M.Sc.) degree in Polymer Science, Fibre Science, Chemistry, Nanotechnology, or allied areas, preferably with experience and NET/GATE qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Jr. Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000 plus HRA @27%.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email to the designated address mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Jr. Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Online Interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.

faq.answer: The Jr. Research Fellow position is on a contractual basis.
